meta.title: Wedding invitation · Diego & Andrea · 01.08.2027
meta.description: We're getting married on January 8, 2027 in Medellín, Colombia. We can't wait to see you!

welcome: After so many shared paths, we decided to walk the rest of the way together. We want to live the most important day of our lives surrounded by the people we love most.
Thank you for being part of our story and for joining us to celebrate the beginning of the next chapter.

venue.intro: We'll be waiting for you at
venue.parking: Parking is limited. We suggest carpooling with other guests or arriving by Uber, so we can all enjoy the night with more peace of mind.

alts: Diego and Andrea laughing next to the Christmas tree
Diego and Andrea hugging in the main square of Villa de Leyva
Diego and Andrea posing together in a park

personal.label: This invitation is personal
personal.confirmed: Thank you for confirming your attendance!
personal.declined: We understand you can't join us. Thank you for being with us in spirit.
personal.roleTitle: You are not just another guest
personal.roleBody: Among all the people we love, we chose you to play a very special role at our wedding. Your energy makes a difference, so we want you to come that day with the best attitude and the desire to live it with us.

dressCode.title: Dress code
dressCode.imageAlt: Outfit examples: men on top, women on the bottom, in black, blue, beige, white and green tones.
dressCode.plain: No prints, please: solid colors only.
dressCode.sneakers: We recommend that the girls wear sneakers for the party.
dressCode.reservedText: These colors are reserved (earth tones), please don't wear them.

noKids.title: Adults only
noKids.text: We want this to be a night to enjoy without worries. For that reason, we won't be able to welcome children at the party. Thank you for understanding.
